source.description:
Finish the release deliverable from xtmux-r6g.1: publish @jaggerxtrm/xtmux to npm. Deferred out of sprint because it needs one-time npmjs.com configuration (not a repo change).

## Context

- v0.1.0 tagged and GH-released 2026-07-17: https://github.com/Jaggerxtrm/xtmux/releases/tag/v0.1.0
- release.yml (main) already contains `npm publish --access public --provenance`; the last run failed with `404 The requested resource '@jaggerxtrm/xtmux@0.1.0' could not be found or you do not have permission to access it.` The package has never actually been published — curl on the registry returns `{"error":"Not found"}`; PR#20 shipped the tarball infra but no tag ever fired the workflow before.
- Failed run for reference: https://github.com/Jaggerxtrm/xtmux/actions/runs/29545471622

## Two paths (pick one)

### Path A — OIDC Trusted Publisher (matches current workflow, keeps provenance)

1. On npmjs.com, log in as the `@jaggerxtrm` scope owner.
2. Navigate to the org/scope settings → Trusted Publishers.
3. Add a publisher: repo `Jaggerxtrm/xtmux`, workflow file `.github/workflows/release.yml`, environment blank.
4. Re-run https://github.com/Jaggerxtrm/xtmux/actions/runs/29545471622 (or move v0.1.0 tag to head to trigger a fresh run).

No repo changes required.

### Path B — Classic token (fastest, drops provenance for now)

1. `npm token create --type automation` (or the modern granular equivalent) on the `@jaggerxtrm` scope.
2. Repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret: `NPM_TOKEN`.
3. In `.github/workflows/release.yml`, replace the publish step:
   ```yaml
   - env: { NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }} }
     run: npm publish --access public
   ```
4. Re-run the failed release (as above).

Path A is preferred long-term because provenance stays.

## Acceptance

- `npm view @jaggerxtrm/xtmux versions` returns `[ '0.1.0' ]`.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` publishes cleanly on the NEXT tag push without manual intervention.
- Bead xtmux-r6g.1 already documents the release cadence; no doc changes needed here unless Path B is chosen (add a comment on why provenance was skipped).
